subject.title: tools.exec.approvalRunningNoticeMs is documented but rejected by the 2026.3.24 config schema

question: Should maintainers adopt/rebase the existing external schema repair or close/replace it with a narrow same-repo fix for the `tools.exec.approvalRunningNoticeMs` schema mismatch?
rationale: The bug is clear and small, but there is still an open external closing-reference candidate plus a closed same-repo PR with mixed stale changes, so automation should not create a competing fix until maintainers choose the landing vehicle.

options.title: Resolve candidate, land narrow fix
